# Data Table

Display and categorise a lot of data with rows and columns.
See [Data Table guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/data-table/design/)

<Canvas of={TableStories.Basic} />

### Selection

Add a `ds-table-row--selected` modifier class to the table row elements to highligh selected rows.

<Canvas of={TableStories.Selection} />

### Resize

Add a `<div class="ds-table-resizer"></div>` to the table header elements.<br />
It will be displayed when hovering headers.

<Canvas of={TableStories.Resize} />

### Condensed

Add the `ds-table--condensed` modifier to the `<table>` html element.

<Canvas of={TableStories.Condensed} />

### Expandable

Expandable tables allow user to evaluate additional information without losing their context.

Recommendations

- Indent the content of expanded row to align with the first column
- Use row dividers to help understand boundaries (using `ds-table-row--dividers` modifier)

<Canvas of={TableStories.Expandable} />

```css
.align-baseline {
  vertical-align: baseline;
}
.table-expandedrow-item {
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.table-expandedrow-item:first-child {
  padding-left: 3.5rem;
}
.table-expandedrow-item > label {
  display: block;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
```
